title: I caught the moon — board clip 2
prompt: A hand reaches in and picks the pane with the moon in it out of the pile, holds it up, then slips it into a jacket pocket at the bottom of the frame. The other panes are gathered up too. The person's own point of view, camera at eye level. A woman's voice says: "I kept that piece. And I kept the other ones too. I put that piece in my pocket. Now I have the moon in my pocket."
